name: Ice Rescue Simulator VR
detailed_description:
Ice Rescue Simulator VR – a fun simulator that teaches the basics of safe behavior on frozen bodies of water and rescue techniques in emergency situations. The player takes on the role of a rescuer stranded on thin ice, where every wrong move can lead to tragedy.

You will learn to analyze the situation, check the ice’s strength, use improvised objects for rescue, provide first aid, and make life-saving decisions.

Key Features:

  • Diverse Rescue Scenarios – Choose the right strategy: crawl toward the victim, use a rope, a board, a stick, or other available tools to safely pull the person out of the water.

  • Interactive Environment – Pick up and use objects, throw them to the victim, check ice strength by moving and striking, and interact with various elements of the world.

  • Training and Evaluation System – The game not only tests your skills but also teaches key rescue principles, evaluating your actions and giving recommendations for improvement.

  • Different Difficulty Levels and Weather Conditions – Face challenges in various situations: a clear day, snowfall, night, or storm. Each scenario requires a unique approach to rescue!

Are you ready to take on the challenge of nature and become a true rescuer?

Your choices can save a life – or lead to tragedy. Test your skills and find out if you’re prepared for extreme conditions!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2080
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • VR Support: Open XR с поддержкой Steam VR
